texts.error.no_sgb: A Game Boy game needs the Super Game Boy cartridge '%1', which is not in the project.
texts.slot.game.help: A Super Nintendo cartridge (.sfc, .smc), or a Game Boy cartridge (.gb, .gbc) to play in a Super Game Boy, whose cartridge and boot ROM are then asked for as firmware.
texts.slot.msu1.help: The MSU-1 files of a cartridge that uses them: the .msu file and the tracks -1.pcm, -2.pcm and so on. Their names must start with the cartridge's file name (game.msu, game-1.pcm).
texts.slot.save.help: Battery memory to start from, as bsnes writes it (.srm). Without one the cartridge starts empty.
texts.setting.leftport.about: What is plugged into the first controller port.
texts.setting.rightport.about: What is plugged into the second controller port. A multitap gives players 2 to 5.
texts.setting.region.about: An NTSC (60 Hz) or a PAL (50 Hz) console. Auto takes the cartridge's.
texts.setting.supergameboy.about: Which Super Game Boy plays a Game Boy game. Each needs its own cartridge and boot ROM.
texts.setting.entropy.about: What memory holds at power-on: a pattern like a real console's (Low), zeros (None) or random-looking values (High). The same every time here.
texts.setting.hotfixes.about: bsnes's fixes for two games that misbehave because of their own bugs.
texts.setting.fastppu.about: Draws a line at a time. Off, bsnes draws a pixel at a time: slower, and right for the few games that change the picture mid-line.
texts.setting.deinterlace.about: With the fast picture processor, shows both fields of an interlaced picture at once.
texts.setting.nospritelimit.about: With the fast picture processor, draws every sprite on a line, not the console's 32.
texts.setting.novramblocking.about: Lets a game write video memory while the picture is drawn, which a console ignores. Some fan translations need it.
texts.setting.fastdsp.about: A faster sound chip. Off, bsnes runs it cycle by cycle.
texts.setting.cubic.about: Smooths the sound with cubic interpolation instead of the console's own filter.
texts.setting.echoshadow.about: Keeps the sound chip's echo apart from the memory a game sees. Some fan translations need it.
texts.setting.delayedsync.about: Lets a coprocessor run ahead of the processor and meet it less often, which is faster.
texts.setting.preferhle.about: Uses bsnes's own DSP-1 to DSP-4, ST010 and Cx4 instead of their firmware.
texts.setting.cpuoverclock.about: The processor's speed. 100 is a console's.
texts.setting.fastmath.about: Gives multiplication and division results at once, not after the console's delay.
texts.setting.sa1overclock.about: The SA-1 coprocessor's speed. 100 is the real chip's.
texts.setting.superfxoverclock.about: The Super FX coprocessor's speed. 100 is the real chip's.
texts.setting.overscan.about: Shows the 8 lines above and below the picture that a television hid.
texts.firmware.sgb1.about: The Super Game Boy's cartridge (256 KiB).
texts.firmware.sgb1_boot.about: The boot ROM inside the Super Game Boy (256 bytes).
texts.firmware.sgb2.about: The Super Game Boy 2's cartridge (512 KiB).
texts.firmware.sgb2_boot.about: The boot ROM inside the Super Game Boy 2 (256 bytes).
texts.game_firmware.about: The firmware of this cartridge's %1 chip, program and data in one file.
texts.game_firmware.about_hle: The firmware of this cartridge's %1 chip, program and data in one file. Not needed with Prefer Coprocessor HLE on.
